'''Aini binti Ideris''' is a Malaysian academic and veterinarian. She served as the 8th Vice-Chancellor of [[Universiti Putra Malaysia|UPM]] from 1 January 2016 until 31 August 2020. Her research interests include  disease control and productions of vaccines for poultry.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.upm.edu.my/about_us/from_the_vice_chancellors_desk/profile-8195|title=Profile {{!}} Universiti Putra Malaysia|website=www.upm.edu.my|language=en|access-date=2018-08-21}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.researchsea.com/html/experts.php/eid/21/research/aini_ideris.html|title=ResearchSEA - Details of (Professor Datin Paduka Dr.) Aini Ideris|last=IT2G|website=www.researchsea.com|language=en|access-date=2018-08-21}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.thestar.com.my/news/education/2017/12/10/prof-aini-stays-on-as-upm-vc/|title=Prof Aini stays on as UPM V-C - Education {{!}} The Star Online|date=2017-12-10|website=www.thestar.com.my|access-date=2018-08-21}}</ref>

==Awards==
In 2011, Professor Dr. Aini received the [[National Academic Award]] (AAN) 2010 for the Innovation and Product Commercialisation Award Category, for the innovation and commercialisation of the [[Newcastle disease]] (ND V4-UPM) vaccines.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.wvpa.net/honourdetails.php?vet=21|title=WVPA|website=www.wvpa.net|access-date=2018-08-21}}</ref>
